name: May Club
source:
The year is 2023, and you play the role of Kudou Hajime, a young man who has just finished his studies at Jiyugaoka University.

You are enjoying some downtime after graduation before you are scheduled to start your training with a CAT company and enter the corporate world as a "wage-slave".
One February afternoon you receive a flyer advertising a Virtual Reality Dating Simulator called May Club, apparently the most advanced human interface unit of this type to be developed. In May Club, you can supposedly act out any desire you wish with other May Club users, a world where "virtually" anything is possible and physically represented, and inhibitions are forgotten.
Naturally, you're intrigued, and make it a point to spend your vacation time at May Club hoping to meet the woman of your dreams before starting your new life.

[Edited from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20011021011426/http://www.animetric.com/bgames/may.html]Animetric.com[/url]]
translation:
时间是2023年，你扮演的是刚从自由丘大学毕业的青年工藤肇。你正在享受毕业后的休息时光，之后将开始在CAT公司的培训，进入企业界成为一名“打工人”。二月的某个下午，你收到了一张宣传名为May Club的虚拟现实约会模拟器的传单——据称是此类设备中最先进的人机界面。在May Club中，你可以与其他用户一起实现任何愿望，一个“虚拟”中一切皆有可能、能被具象化呈现、且可以忘却所有矜持的世界。自然，你被吸引了，决定在假期里前往May Club，希望在开始新生活之前遇见你梦中的女人。

[编辑自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20011021011426/http://www.animetric.com/bgames/may.html]Animetric.com[/url]]
